name: varysheet
description: Notion-like flexible table information management system on Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2

scripts.db:migrate:local: npm run db:migrate:local:control && npm run db:migrate:local:tables
scripts.db:migrate:local:tables: wrangler d1 migrations apply cloudnotion-tables-basic --local && wrangler d1 migrations apply cloudnotion-tables-pro --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npm run db:migrate:remote:control && npm run db:migrate:remote:tables
scripts.db:migrate:remote:tables: wrangler d1 migrations apply cloudnotion-tables-basic --remote && wrangler d1 migrations apply cloudnotion-tables-pro --remote
scripts.check:scripts: node --check scripts/sync-d1-ids.mjs && node --check scripts/sync-shard-schema.mjs && node --check scripts/migrate-split-data.mjs && node --check scripts/check-routes.mjs && node --check scripts/smoke-test.mjs
